title: thinopyrum bessarabicum
intro: Thinopyrum bessarabicum, commonly known as Bessarabian wheatgrass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Bessarabian wheatgrass include wound healing, reducing oxidative stress, and exerting a protective effect on the liver. Bioactive constituents of Thinopyrum bessarabicum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
